opinions.text: D. C. S. D. Ind. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 470 U. S. 1083.] Appellants having reapplied for a stay in this case pending its final resolution in this Court and it appearing that all of the requirements for the issuance of a stay are satisfied, the application is granted and it is ordered that the judgment of the District Court for the Southern District of Indiana is stayed until further order of the Court.
